jobs.occupation: Mobile CRM Team Lead in Berlin - German Speaking (m/w/d) (CRM-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
About UsCustomlytics is the leading app marketing agency & consultancy in the DACH region. We make apps successful and professionalize the app industry, working with every relevant app business in the market. Can you imagine a world without apps? Neither can we!

As our CRM Lead, you will play a key role in shaping and scaling Customlytics CRM and customer engagement capabilities across the mobile app ecosystem. This is a highly strategic and hands-on role, ideal for someone who is data-driven, customer-centric, and passionate about creating impactful lifecycle marketing experiences. You will have the freedom to independently drive initiatives forward while collaborating closely with our Paid Media, Design, and Consultant teams.

Your mission is to elevate how leading app businesses build and nurture relationships with their users. You will own and further develop our CRM offering across channels such as push notifications, email, in-app messaging, and automation journeys, helping clients maximize retention, engagement, and lifetime value. Working with leading CRM platforms including Braze, MoEngage, and Airship, you will lead end-to-end CRM initiatives, from strategy development and campaign execution to testing, personalization, and performance optimization,while ensuring high quality across the team.

You will collaborate with some of the most relevant app businesses in the DACH market like Telekom and REWE, helping them create impactful customer lifecycle programs that drive engagement and long-term growth. In addition to guiding and developing team members, you will establish scalable CRM processes, foster best practices, and contribute to building a high-performing customer lifecycle marketing function.
Your mission
• Lead and mentor a team of CRM specialists while ensuring the successful execution and continuous optimization of high-performing CRM campaigns for clients across a wide range of app verticals.
• Develop and evolve CRM and lifecycle marketing strategies that align with clients’ growth objectives and drive user engagement, retention, and long-term customer value.
• Plan, execute, and optimize multi-channel CRM campaigns across push notifications, in-app messaging, email, and automation flows to increase engagement and conversion for leading mobile apps.
• Leverage customer and campaign data to generate actionable insights, identify optimization opportunities, and support data-driven growth decisions across marketing and product initiatives.
• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including design, copywriting, Paid Media, the Consultant team, and the leadership team, to deliver impactful and seamless customer experiences throughout the user lifecycle.
• Lead by example as a hands-on CRM expert while mentoring and supporting a team of CRM specialists to ensure high-quality execution and continuous development.
• Stay ahead of industry trends, platform updates, and emerging CRM technologies to continuously enhance our CRM offering and establish best practices across the organization.

Your profile
• 5+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, email marketing, or mobile app marketing, ideally within a fast-paced agency or app-driven environment.
• Proven experience developing, executing, and optimizing successful CRM and customer engagement campaigns that drive retention, engagement, and revenue growth.
• Strong hands-on experience with leading CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Braze, MoEngage, CleverTap, Batch, Airship, Iterable, or similar tools.
• Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple client projects, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret customer and campaign data, derive actionable insights, and make data-driven marketing decisions.
• Excellent communication and leadership skills with experience mentoring or leading team members in a collaborative, high-performance environment.
• Fluent in English and German (minimum C1 level in German), with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

Your Extra
• Your Growth & Development: Access to certifications, 360° feedback, and salary progression. Real opportunities to grow together with your team and the company.
• Remote Work: Work remotely for up to 90 days per year; anywhere in Germany or internationally.
• Office Vibes in Friedrichshain: Snacks, drinks, height-adjustable desks, and focus rooms for deep, concentrated work.
• Top-Notch Equipment: MacBook, noise-cancelling headphones, and all the tools you need to succeed.
• Core Working Hours: Making collaboration easy and your schedule steady.
• Corporate Benefits: Exclusive deals with popular online brands.
• Support for Parents: Extra support for parents with preschool-aged children.
• Team Culture & Events: From monthly activities to our big annual meetup in Berlin, we create space to celebrate, connect, and grow as a team.
• German Language Courses: We support you with professional online German classes.
• Referral Bonus: Whether new teammates or new clients, your recommendations pay off.

We're committed to diversity and equal opportunity for all, welcoming individuals of any gender, age, origin, religion, disability, or sexual orientation. If you're creative, problem-solving, and passionate about app marketing, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and be yourself, in an atmosphere where diversity is celebrated and embraced.

As Office Operations Manager, you'll be the backbone of our day-to-day office operations and the person who keeps everything running smoothly even when things get busy.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced environment: you'll be balancing planned projects with spontaneous requests that need to be handled on the spot. It is the exact opposite of monotonous and will give you lots of opportunity to get creative and bring ideas. Aside from the operational duties, you also make sure our people feel genuinely at home in the office.

If you're an organizational talent who thrives on taking ownership, enjoys variety, and stays composed when priorities shift unexpectedly, this role is for you!

This is a** full-time**, Berlin-based position with an immediate start.

Your mission

- Own and optimize office operations, including procurement processes, supplier management, and inventory control
- Ensure the office, workspaces, kitchen, and common areas are always well-organized, well-maintained, and fully functional
- Handle day-to-day operational tasks such as receiving deliveries, coordinating larger orders, minor repairs, and organizing storage areas
- Juggle multiple ongoing tasks in a high-paced environment, while staying ready to jump on spontaneous, ad hoc requests and knowing how to prioritize on the fly
- Collaborate closely and continuously with IT, Finance, and People teams to ensure efficient, compliant processes
- Support Onboarding and Offboarding processes together with People Ops and IT
- Act as the central point of contact for external partners such as suppliers, insurance consultants and landlords
- Analyze office usage and costs, identify opportunities for optimization, and support reporting these

- Plan and organize internal events, and contribute to employee engagement and sustainability initiatives
- Stay flexible and adaptable as priorities shift, adjusting plans and approaches as the business needs evolve

Job requirements

What You Bring

- At least two years of experience in office management or a related field, ideally with a background in hospitality or event management
- Excellent written and spoken German (minimum C1 level) and English; additional European languages are a plus
- Strong organizational skills paired with a structured, reliable, and solution-oriented way of working
- A proactive attitude and positive energy that helps create a motivating and pleasant office atmosphere
- High resilience to stress and pressure, with the ability to stay calm, keep a clear overview, and juggle competing priorities in a fast-moving, high-paced environment
- Comfort with ambiguity and spontaneous requests; you know how to quickly assess what's urgent and adjust your plan accordingly

- Flexible work arrangements, including remote work options and the ability to plan workations.
- A purpose-driven environment where you can grow as a Sustainability Ambassador and contribute to meaningful projects.
- An international and diverse team that values ownership, collaboration, and professional growth.

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Discover Impactful Work

As a Sales Engineer Gauging within the Production Process & Analytics (PPA) business unit of the Chemical Analysis Division (CAD) at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will play a key role in driving commercial success across our Quality Control Systems portfolio.

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities while growing existing customer relationships across assigned industrial markets and territory. Reporting to the Global Commercial Leader, you will execute strategic sales initiatives, identify opportunities for market expansion, and deliver value-driven solutions that help customers improve their manufacturing processes.

Your technical expertise, consultative selling approach, and ability to build lasting customer partnerships will be essential in achieving sales objectives and supporting the continued growth and profitability of the business.

- Develop and execute territory sales plans to identify and secure new business opportunities.
- Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through quotation, negotiation and closing.
- Identify AI-enabled solutions and digital services to support business growth and deliver measurable customer value.
- Maintain an accurate sales forecast and opportunity pipeline using Salesforce.com.
- Collaborate with partners and representatives to support commercial growth.
- Provide valuable market intelligence by monitoring market trends, competitive activities and customer-specific requirements.
- Develop trusted relationships with existing and prospective customers.
- Analyze customer production processes and recommend technical solutions that improve quality, productivity and operational efficiency.
- Engage customers with AI-enabled discussions and commercial solutions.
- Deliver outstanding customer experience through responsiveness, technical expertise and solution-oriented support.
- Demonstrate and present the technical capabilities and business value of Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Quality Control Systems.
- Collaborate closely with application specialists, service engineers, software experts and product management to develop customer-specific solutions.
- Maintain a high level of product, application, industry and AI knowledge to effectively position our solutions.
- Travel throughout the assigned territory and internationally as required, with approximately 50% overnight travel.

What to expect:

- Drive sales growth by achieving commercial targets across the assigned territory.
- Identify and develop new business opportunities while expanding existing customer relationships.
- Lead complex technical sales engagements from prospecting through contract negotiation and closing.
- Deliver consultative, value-based sales solutions tailored to customer manufacturing processes.
- Work cross-functionally with technical experts, service teams and product management.
- Utilize Salesforce.com to manage opportunities, forecasting and customer engagement.
- Monitor market trends and competitive activities to support strategic business growth.
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific through regular customer visits and extensive travel.

Keys to Success:

Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent technical experience.

Experience

- Minimum of 3 years of successful technical sales experience in capital equipment, industrial instrumentation, process analytics or industrial automation.
- Proven experience selling complex technical solutions to manufacturing customers.
- Experience within one or more of the following industries is highly desirable:
- Metal
- Packaging & Converting
- Battery Manufacturing
- Experience working with distributors or channel partners is desirable.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills with a customer-focused mindset.
- Excellent presentation and communication skills for both technical and business audiences.
- Ability to understand complex manufacturing processes and translate them into customer-focused technical solutions.
- Understanding of AI and digital technologies as emerging commercial enablers within industrial markets.
- Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
- Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce.com preferred) together with digital sales and collaboration tools.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken).
- Additional language skills are an advantage.
- Valid driver's license and willingness to travel extensively.

Benefits:

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

jobs.occupation: AI Engineer – Research Algorithm/Model Expert (Scientific Brain Domain) (Ingenieur/in - Chemietechnik)
jobs.description:
About the Company

CHN Energy Europe Research GmbH (CHEER) is a subsidiary of CHN Energy Investment Group (China Energy) based in Berlin, Germany. Being an integral part of China Energy’s globalized research and development layout, CHEER features in integrated European-Chinese innovation culture and advanced technology, and operates business in new energy technology research and development with purposes of promoting and accelerating carbon neutrality and making its own contribution in alleviating global climate change.

Its parent company, China Energy, operates eight business segments including coal, thermal power, new energy, hydro-power, transportation, coal-to-chemicals, environmental technology and finance. Those businesses distribute in more than 10 countries and regions, including China, Europe, the United States, Canada and Australia. It is the world’s largest producer of coal, thermal power, wind power, as well as coal-to-chemicals. It is ranked 92nd in the Fortune Global 500 in 2025.

Centered on the green development strategy and the strategy of innovation-driven scientific and technological development, CHEER is committed to building a world-class research institute with global competitiveness. We focus on six key R&D areas: diversified power conversion, advanced chemical engineering, hydrogen energy, artificial intelligence, energy storage, and new environmental protection technologies.

We are building teams to develop cutting-edge sustainable and affordable technologies to improve energy efficiency, protect the environment, and mitigate climate change. Our ability to excel depends on the integrity, knowledge, skill, imagination, passion, and teamwork of people like you. Currently we have openings for leading experts with a range of focus areas including energy, chemistry, and artificial intelligence. We offer competitive compensation packages and excellent benefits.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Develop AI algorithms and technologies to optimize predictive models and improve materials development strategies, thereby accelerating the discovery and optimization of catalysts.
2. Apply robotics-based high-throughput experimentation to rapidly synthesize and test a vast array of catalyst candidates, expediting the identification of highly efficient catalysts.
3. Use AI algorithms to analyze chemical data, predict the properties of potential catalysts, and support the design of new catalysts with improved activity and selectivity.
4. Employ AI-based computational modeling techniques to predict catalyst behavior at the atomic level, simulate reactant adsorption, activation, and reaction pathways, identify promising catalyst candidates, and guide experimental work toward the most effective design directions.

Qualification Requirements:

1. Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field (e.g., Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Energy Engineering, Electrical Engineering).
2. Professional experience in AI algorithms or related research/industry projects.
3. Deep understanding of Transformer architectures and their variants; familiarity with large models such as BERT, GPT, and LLaMA.
4. Experience with distributed training, model parallelism, and model compression.
5. Proven experience in large model development and optimization; proficient with frameworks such as ChatGPT, DeepSpeed, Megatron; knowledge of RLHF and PEFT.
6. Strong research track record with publications in top international conferences/journals, or highly cited research outputs/patents.
7. Excellent project management and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in interdisciplinary and multicultural teams.
8. Very good English skills are required; German and/or Chinese is an advantage.

Join us and become a leader in driving clean energy innovation, together shaping the brilliant future of the new energy sector!

We Offer

- Competitive compensation and benefits: We offer an attractive compensation package based on the responsibilities of the role, the candidate’s qualifications, relevant professional experience, and overall fit. Additional benefits and supplementary payments may be granted in accordance with company policies and individual eligibility.
- Excellent research environment**:** Sufficient research funding and access to advanced digital tools and innovative technologies.
- Innovative workplace: Exciting and diverse tasks in an international R&D setting with a collaborative, open atmosphere.
- Room for creativity: Freedom to contribute your own ideas and actively shape forward-looking solutions in sustainable energy, technology, and organizational development.
- International collaboration: Interdisciplinary projects and partnerships with renowned academic and industry players across Europe, including opportunities for international exchange.
- Career development: Tailored training programs, individual career pathways, and support for participation in professional events and confe

Application process:

Please send your application documents by email to

recruitment@chnenergyeurope.com

Subject line: “[Position] – [Your Name]”.

Your application should include:

- CV (including information/listing of representative research projects for R&D positions)
- University certificates / transcripts (if available)
- Reference letters from previous employers (if available)

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your data for the purpose of the recruitment process.

All documents will be treated confidentially in accordance with GDPR. We retain applications for up to six months after completion of the recruitment process, unless you give explicit consent for longer storage.

For questions regarding the position or the application process, please contact our Recruiting Team:

recruitment@chnenergyeurope.com

The SE P DM organization is responsible for developing procurement strategies for direct materials that will ensure the optimization of Siemens Energy’s competitive position.

As Corporate Commodity Manager for Steel, you will be responsible for shaping Siemens Energy’s global steel procurement strategy across all Business Areas. You will monitor and steer a complex, highly regulated supply environment, build competitive, resilient and sustainable supply chains, and serve as Siemens Energy’s subject matter expert for steel, with a strong emphasis on the European steel ecosystem and its regulatory landscape.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Global ownership of direct and indirect (n‑tier) steel spend across all Siemens Energy entities, ensuring supply chain transparency and optimization
* Development and execution of a comprehensive Steel Commodity Strategy, including lower‑tier strategies, targeting competitiveness, resilience, supplier diversification, and sustainability
* Central steel subject-matter expertise providing guidance on market developments, trade and decarbonization regulations, and support for scenario analyses, strategic decisions, and executive/board-level discussions
* Establishment and leadership of an internal Steel Commodity Circle and cultivation of an external stakeholder network across relevant partners and functions
* Strategic supplier relationship management with mills, distributors, and service centers, enabling long-term agreements and multi-tier sourcing frameworks
* Supply chain risk identification and mitigation, leveraging geopolitical, regulatory, and market developments while integrating ESG and sustainability requirements across the steel value chain

What You Bring

* University degree in engineering, metallurgy, or business, combined with extensive experience in procurement or consulting, preferably within metals and steel
* In-depth knowledge of steel markets, value chain dynamics, and sustainability and decarbonization challenges
* Ability to operate effectively in multicultural environments and within complex, functional matrix organizations
* Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management capabilities at all organizational levels
* Strategic mindset supported by strong analytical rigor and structured problem-solving skills
* Fluency in German and English (spoken and written)

You will join a dedicated team of procurement experts that ensures Siemens Energy’s supply for critical raw materials by understanding entire value chains and anticipating risks and developing opportunities. At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company.
